title: BookingsBookingCancelledPayload
description: Payload of `bookings.booking.cancelled` version 1. A booking was cancelled. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

order_id.description: The order of fulfilment on site it is.

partner_id.description: The Location's Partner; the envelope's `partner_id` too.

customer_id.description: The customer (a user id); fetch personal data from the API when it is needed.

state.description: Where the booking stands after the change.

starts_at.description: The slot's start; for pickup and return, the pickup's.

ends_at.description: When the job is expected to end.

version.description: The booking's version after the change.

by.description: Who: the `customer`, the Location's `staff`, the `agent`, the `platform`, or the `system` clock.

currency.description: The currency of every amount, in its minor unit.

fee_kept.description: What was kept, in minor units of the currency.

refunded.description: What goes back, in minor units of the currency.

agent_never_came.description: No Agent arrived thirty minutes after the slot's end: everything goes back, and the Partner's record counts a missed booking.
